63301.commentary: (VINa) sīs'ūpagan'ti-ādīsu sīsaṃ upagacchatī'ti sīs'ūpagaṃ, potthakesu pana sīs'ūpakan'ti likhitaṃ, yassa kassaci sīs'ālaṅ'kārass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: nānappakārakaṃ nāma katam'pi akatam'pi kat'ākatam'pi. kataṃ nāma sīs'ūpagaṃ gīv'ūpagaṃ hatth'ūpagaṃ pād'ūpagaṃ kaṭ'ūpagaṃ. akataṃ nāma ghanakataṃ vuccati. kat'ākataṃ nāma tadubhayaṃ.

63302.meaning1: name of an arahant nun; Sāriputta's sister
63302.commentary: (THIa) tassā nāmaggahaṇadivase cālā'ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu, tassā kaniṭṭhāya upacālā'ti, atha tassā kaniṭṭhāya sīs'ūpacālā'ti. imā tisso'pi dhammasenāpatissa kaniṭṭhabhaginiyo, imāsaṃ puttānam'pi tiṇṇaṃ idam'eva nāmaṃ. ye sandhāya theragāthāya, cāle upacāle sīsūpacāle'ti (theragā. 42) āgataṃ.
63302.notes: Therīgāthā verses 196-203 (TH8.1, TH61) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ sīsūpacālā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.

63305.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of sīsa
63305.meaning1: headed by; under the heading of

63306.commentary: (SNa) moḷiyasīvako'ti sīvako'ti tassa nāmaṃ. cūḷā pan'assa atthi, tasmā moḷiyasīvako'ti vuccati.

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe. atha kho moḷiyasīvako paribbājako yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.

63308.meaning1: cemetery gate; entrance to the charnel ground

examples.text: rattiyā sudaṃ tikkhattuṃ vuṭṭhāsi pabhātanti maññamāno. atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena sīvathikadvāraṃ ten'upasaṅkami. amanussā dvāraṃ vivariṃsu.

63309.meaning2: place where the dead bodies are thrown to rot away
63309.meaningLit: safe place for bones; where bones sleep
63309.notes: (PED) perhaps = *Sk. śivālaya; Kern derives it as śīvan 'lying' + atthi 'bone

examples.text: kukkuro āviñcheyya, gāmaṃ pavekkhāmī'ti, siṅgālo āviñcheyya, sīvathikaṃ pavekkhāmī'ti, makkaṭo āviñcheyya, vanaṃ pavekkhāmī'ti.

63310.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in receiving
63310.commentary: (ANa) lābhīnaṃ yadidaṃ sīvalī'ti ṭhapetvā tathāgataṃ lābhīnaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sīvalitthero aggo'ti dasseti.
63310.notes: Theragāthā verse 60 (TH1.60, TH60) is attributed to him.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ lābhīnaṃ yadidaṃ sīvali.
itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā sīvalitthero gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.
upadhī te samatikkantā, āsavā te padālitā, sīho'si anupādāno, pahīnabhayabheravo.
rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappessāma

63314.meaning1: name of a military general in Vesālī

examples.text: dutiyam'pi kho sīho senāpati yena nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā nigaṇṭhaṃ nāṭaputtaṃ etadavoca, icchām'ahaṃ, bhante, samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitun'ti.
ahaṃ, bhante, dāyako dānapati, mayhaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato, sīho senāpati dāyako kārako saṅgh'upaṭṭhāko'ti.

imāni te, deva caturāsīti rathasahassāni sīhacammaparivārāni byagghacamma-parivārāni dīpicamma-parivārāni paṇḍukambalaparivārāni sovaṇṇ'ālaṅ'kārāni sovaṇṇadhajāni hemajālapaṭicchannāni vejayanta-ratha-ppamukhāni.
uddhato capalo bhikkhu, paṃsukūlena pāruto, kapī'va sīhacammena, na so ten'upasobhati.

rañño, ānanda, mahāsudassanassa… caturāsīti rathasahassāni ahesuṃ sīhacamma-parivārāni byagghacamma-parivārāni dīpicamma-parivārāni paṇḍukambalaparivārāni sovaṇṇ'ālaṅ'kārāni sovaṇṇadhajāni hemajālapaṭicchannāni vejayanta-ratha-ppamukhāni

63319.commentary: (MNt) hatth'attharaṇā hatthirūpavicittā. ass'attharaka-sīh'attharak'ādayo'pi assasīharūp'ādivicittā eva attharakā, citt'attharakaṃ nānārūpehi c'eva nānāvidhamālākamm'ādīhi ca vicittaṃ attharakaṃ.

examples.text: dasabalasamannāgato, bhikkhave, tathāgato catūhi ca vesārajjehi samannāgato āsabhaṃ ṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti, parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati, brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti

tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca mahāmoggallāno āyasmā ca ānando avāpuraṇaṃ ādāya vihāre āhiṇḍanti, abhikkamath'āyasmanto, abhikkamath'āyasmanto! idān'āyasmā sāriputto bhagavato sammukhā sīhanādaṃ nadissatī'ti.

63322.commentary: (DNa) ke pana sīhanāde'ti ko pana sīhanādo siṅgālassa ca sīhanādassa ca ko sambandho'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: sīho, bhikkhave, migarājā sāy'anhasamayaṃ āsayā nikkhamati. āsayā nikkhamitvā vijambhati. vijambhitvā samantā catuddisaṃ anuviloketi. samantā catuddisaṃ anuviloketvā tikkhattuṃ sīhanādaṃ nadati. tikkhattuṃ sīhanādaṃ naditvā gocarāya pakkamati.
sīho'ti attānaṃ samekkhiyāna, amaññi kotthu migarāj'āham'asmi, tath'evaso siṅgālakaṃ anadi, ke ca chave siṅgāle ke pana sīhanāde'ti.
niṭṭhitā mahāmoggallānassa sīhanādakathā.
sīhanādaṃ nadatī'ti seṭṭhanādaṃ abhītanādaṃ nadati, sīhanādasadisaṃ vā nādaṃ nadati.

63330.commentary: (ANa) sīhanādikānan'ti sīhanādaṃ nadantānaṃ. (ANt) abhītanādabhāvena sīhassa viya nādo sīhanādo, so etesaṃ atthī'ti sīhanādikā, tesaṃ sīhanādikānaṃ.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sīhanādikānaṃ yadidaṃ piṇḍolabhāradvājo.

63331.meaning2: having a jaw like that of a lion

63333.meaning2: one of the great Himalayan lakes

examples.text: sīhapubb'addhakāyo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.

examples.text: sa sīhapubb'addhasusaṇṭhito ahu, samavaṭṭakkhandho ca cit'antar'aṃso, pubbe suciṇṇena katena kammunā, ahāniyaṃ pubbanimittam'assa taṃ.

63342.meaning1: equal to a lion; like a lion

examples.text: sah'ācaritena chavo sigālo, na kotthuko sīhasamo kadāci, naggo musāvādī gaṇassa satthā, saṅkassar'ācāro na sataṃ sarikkho'ti.

63348.meaningLit: discourse with Sīha the army general

63349.meaningLit: discourse with Sīha the army general

examples.text: rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappessāma pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasi karitvā

63352.meaning1: with a voice like a lion
63352.meaning2: having a voice like a lion

examples.text: pīṇitā tena lābhena, tuṭṭhā sīhassare kuse, sakaraṭṭhāni pāyiṃsu, khattiyā satta tāva'd'e.

63353.meaning1: who has lion-like qualities; with leonine character

examples.text: sīho vata, bho, samaṇo gotamo, sīhavatā ca samuppannā sārīrikā vedanā dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā asātā amanāpā sato sampajāno adhivāseti avihaññamāno'ti.

63354.meaning1: lion grease; oil of a lion

63355.commentary: (NPa) asantāsana-java-parakkam'ādi-visesa-yogena sīho bhagavā, tassa vikkīḷitaṃ desanāvacīkammabhūto vihāro'ti katvā vipallāsa-tappaṭipakkha-paridīpanato sīhassa vikkīḷitaṃ etthā'ti sīhavikkīḷito, nayo. balavisesayogadīpanato vā sīhavikkīḷitasadisattā nayo sīhavikkīḷito.

examples.text: tattha ye samathapubbaṅgamāhi paṭipadāhi niyyanti, te nandiyāvaṭṭena nayena hātabbā, ye vipassanāpubbaṅgamāhi paṭipadāhi niyyanti, te sīhavikkīḷitena nayena hātabbā.

63356.meaning1: remains of a lion kill; lion's leftovers

63357.meaning1: with a jaw like a lion; twenty-second of the thirty-two marks of a great man

examples.text: sīhahanu kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.

63358.meaning1: auspicious mark of having a lion-like jaw

examples.text: ten'assa hanukaṃ cāletvā cāletvā dīgharattaṃ palāpakathāya akathitabhāvaṃ sadevako loko iminā kāraṇena jānātū'ti sīhahanulakkhaṇaṃ nibbattati. lakkhaṇaṃ nāma idam'eva lakkhaṇaṃ.

63361.commentary: (PYt) sīhaḷadīpe'ti sīhaṃ lāti gaṇhātī'ti sīhaḷo lakārassa ḷakāraṃ katvā, sīhabāhunāmako rājā, tassa puttattā vijayakumāro'pi sīhaḷo nāma, tena ādimhi nivāsabhāvena gahitattā dīpo sīhaḷadīpo nāma, tasmiṃ.

examples.text: tattha asamādinnasikkhāpadānaṃ attano jātivayabāhusacc'ādīni paccavekkhitvā ayuttaṃ amhākaṃ evarūpaṃ kātun'ti sampattavatthuṃ avītikkamantānaṃ uppajjamānā virati sampattaviratī'ti veditabbā sīhaḷadīpe cakkanaupāsakassa viya.
kathaṃ [idaṃ padaṃ katthaci sīhaḷapotthake n'atthi] sataṃ

63364.meaning1: solitary like a lion; living alone like a lion; wandering alone like a lion
63364.commentary: (SNa) sīhaṃ'v'ekacaraṃ nāgan'ti ekacaraṃ sīhaṃ viya, ekacaraṃ nāgaṃ viya. gaṇavāsino hi pamattā honti, ekacarā appamattā, tasmā ekacarāva gahitā'ti.

examples.text: eṇijaṅghaṃ kisaṃ vīraṃ, app'āhāraṃ alolupaṃ, sīhaṃ'v'ekacaraṃ nāgaṃ, kāmesu anapekkhinaṃ, upasaṅkamma pucchāma, kathaṃ dukkhā pamuccatī'ti
kadā nu paññāmayam'uggatejaṃ, satthaṃ isīnaṃ sahas'ādiyitvā, māraṃ sasenaṃ sahasā bhañjissaṃ, sīh'āsane taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
kiṃsu chetvā sukhaṃ seti, kiṃsu chetvā na socati, kissassu ekadhammassa, vadhaṃ rocesi gotamā'ti.
piyā su lokasmiṃ kutonidānā, ye vā'pi lobhā vicaranti loke, āsā ca niṭṭhā ca kutonidānā, ye samparāyāya narassa honti.

63368.meaning2: expressing the notion of well, happily and thorough

examples.text: bāhusaccañ'ca sippañ'ca, vinayo ca susikkhito, subhāsitā ca yā vācā, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.

pa, parā, ni, nī, u, du, saṃ, vi, ava, anu, pari, adhi, abhi, pati, su, ā, ati, api, apa, upa, pahāro, parābhavo, nihāro, nīhāro, uhāro, duhāro, saṃhāro, vihāro, avahāro, anuhāro, parihāro, adhihāro, abhihāro, patihāro, suhāro, āhāro, atihāro, apihāro, apahāro, upahāro, evaṃ vīsati upasaggehi ca.

63374.meaning1: (of a suspended monk) properly readmitted; correctly reinstated

examples.text: vakkhati ca, atthi bhikkhave puggalo appatto osāraṇaṃ, tañ'ce saṅgho osāreti, ekacco suosārito, ekacco duosārito'ti tass'attho āgataṭṭhāne'y'eva āvi bhavissatī'ti.
suka-sāḷika-sadd'ettha, daṇḍamāṇavakāni ca, sobhati sabbakālaṃ sā, kuveranaḷinī sadā.

katamāni tīṇi? idha, bhikkhave, kassako gahapati paṭikacc'eva khettaṃ sukaṭṭhaṃ karoti sumatikataṃ.

63381.meaning1: good deed; good action; meritorious act

examples.text: akataṃ dukkaṭaṃ seyyo, pacchā tappati dukkaṭaṃ, katañ'ca sukataṃ seyyo, yaṃ katvā n'ānutappati.
sace kho pana atthi paro loko, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, ath'āhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissāmī'ti, ayam'assa paṭhamo assāso adhigato hoti.
sammādiṭṭhiko kho pana hoti aviparītadassano, atthi dinnaṃ atthi yiṭṭhaṃ atthi hutaṃ, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, atthi ayaṃ loko atthi paro loko, atthi mātā atthi pitā…

63383.commentary: (DNa) sukatakammakarā'ti kiṃ etassa kammena katena, na mayaṃ kiñci labhāmā'ti anujjhāyitvā tuṭṭhahadayā yathā taṃ kammaṃ sukataṃ hoti, evaṃ kārakā.

examples.text: imehi kho, gahapatiputta, pañcahi ṭhānehi ayyirakena heṭṭhimā disā dāsakammakarā paccupaṭṭhitā pañcahi ṭhānehi ayyirakaṃ anukampanti, pubbuṭṭhāyino ca honti, pacchā nipātino ca, dinn'ādāyino ca, sukatakammakarā ca, kittivaṇṇaharā ca.

63384.meaning1: who has done good deeds; who has performed right actions

examples.text: sace, bhikkhave, sattā pubbekatahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, addhā, bhikkhave, tathāgato pubbe sukatakammakārī yaṃ eta'r'ahi evarūpā anāsavā sukhā vedanā vedeti.

idha, bhikkhave, paṇḍito sucintitacintī ca hoti subhāsitabhāsī ca sukatakammakārī ca. no c'etaṃ, bhikkhave, paṇḍito sucintitacintī ca abhavissa subhāsitabhāsī ca sukatakammakārī ca, kena naṃ paṇḍitā jāneyyuṃ.

63386.meaning1: well done and badly done; correctly and incorrectly done; wholesome and unwholesome

examples.text: sace kho pana atthi paro loko, atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, ath'āhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissāmī'ti, ayam'assa paṭhamo assāso adhigato hoti.

63387.meaning1: results and consequences of good deeds

examples.text: māraṇavadhabhay'attano viditvā, paṭivirato paraṃ māraṇāy'ahosi, tena sucaritena saggam'agamā, sukataphalavipākam'anubhosi.

63388.meaning1: remainder of the results and consequences of good deeds

examples.text: laddhāna manussakaṃ bhavaṃ tato caviya, puna sukataphalavipākasesakena, paṭilabhati lapanajaṃ samama'pi, suci ca suvisuddhasusukkaṃ.
saddhassa, bhikkhave, saddhākathā sukathā, sīlavato sīlakathā sukathā, bahussutassa bāhusaccakathā sukathā, cāgavato cāgakathā sukathā, paññavato paññākathā sukathā.

paṇḍitapaṭirūpakānañ'hi santike kathetuṃ dukkhaṃ hoti, te pade pade akkhare akkhare dosam'eva vadanti. ek'antapaṇḍitā pana kathaṃ sutvā sukathitaṃ pasaṃsanti, dukkathite pāḷipada-attha-byañjanesu yaṃ yaṃ virujjhati, taṃ taṃ ujuṃ katvā denti.

sukadariya + tā
